data.name: Dhiyaad
data.gender_notes: Dhiyaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhiyaad is an Arabic name for boys and girls, which means 'prosperous' or 'wealthy'. It is derived from the word 'dhayy', which means 'to increase or prosper'. In Islamic tradition, Dhiyaad is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Dhiyaad carries the meaning “Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Dhiyaad usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Those named Dhiyaad are believed to be blessed with good fortune and prosperity. They are often seen as spiritual individuals who are deeply connected to their faith and values.
data.etymology: Dhiyaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhiyaad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hindi.name: धियाद

in_hindi.long_meaning: धियाद भगवान का कृपा है और इसका अर्थ है कि भगवान की ओर से कृपा होती है और यह रूपये और समृद्धि में बढ़ता है। भगवान का नाम है जो भगवान ने खुद अपने लिए रखा है। यह नाम भगवान की कृपा, शुद्धता, पवित्रता, और दान के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

in_pashto.long_meaning: ږياډ الله دې له په پټې ښودنه ده چې الله له طرفه له لوامعې کړي، او د هغه پر لور د لوامحو له په پښو سره، او د رزيق او ځواک ته په پښو سره پورته کوي. الله دې له اسماني په اسماني ښودنه ده چې الله پر خپل خاطره ددې نوم کاروي. ددې نوم په څير الله د لوامحو، عفاف، ستر، او جود په څير په پښو سره پورته کوي.
